context_requirements: Expression of imidazoline I1/I2 receptors or related binding sites
A signaling pathway whose activity is tonically modulated by imidazoline receptors
For antagonist-only effects, endogenous agonist tone or receptor constitutive activity
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple cell lines that is not explained by generic stress or cytotoxicity
Evidence of imidazoline receptor expression and downstream signaling in these lines combined with measurable transcriptional output

evidence.supports: Imidazoline I2 receptor modulation can affect PI3K/AKT, HIF-1α, VEGF and RTP801 in glioma cells, but this is an agonist/protection context and does not establish antagonist-driven transcription in the tested lines.
